reason: The supplied hot-loop assembly has four separate operand loads before the four MOPAs, while the SME2 probe emits paired loads. I rank compiler_codegen first as the clearest n=512 test against that exact compiler output. vector_access, n512_fast_path, tail_alignment, sme_fp32_schedule, and cache_blocking propose substantially the same paired-load change; test one implementation first and treat the rest as duplicates unless their source changes differ. za_four_tile_reuse and assembly_audit are the same indirect-store idea, supported by a local code-generation probe and external implementation report, so test one after paired loads. The remaining proposals change transpose or data layout, streaming-region structure, or MOPA scheduling. Their benefits are less direct or their packing, correctness, or implementation risks are higher. Historical scores are noisy and do not establish gains or causes; every performance claim remains a hypothesis.
